items.title: Sheba Medical Center Partners with OpenAI in First International ChatGPT for Healthcare Deployment - HIT Consultant
items.summary: # Sheba Medical Center Partners with OpenAI in First International ChatGPT for Healthcare Deployment. * Israel’s Sheba Medical Center (ranked among Newsweek’s World’s Best Hospitals for 8 consecutive years) has entered an official partnership with OpenAI to execute the first global, hospital-wide rollout of ChatGPT for Healthcare. * Gives physicians, nurses, researchers, and operational staff access to generative AI models pre-calibrated to synthesize peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical guidelines, and internal hospital protocols with full, verifiable citations. Eyal Zimlichman and Technology Director Alon Agmon within Sheba’s ARC (Accelerate, Redesign, Collaborate) ecosystem to establish a blueprinted model for fully AI-powered health systems. **OpenAI’s ARC Collaboration Inks First International Hospital Deal with Sheba**. To solve workflow fragmentation and build the operational infrastructure for a fully AI-powered hospital, Sheba Medical Center has announced a collaboration with OpenAI. Driven by the ARC (Accelerate, Redesign, Collaborate) innovation arm, the agreement marks OpenAI’s first international deployment of ChatGPT for Healthcare across a complete hospital network.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group Launches AI Hotel Discovery App in ChatGPT - Hotel News Resource
items.summary: # Radisson Hotel Group Launches AI Hotel Discovery App in ChatGPT. **In Brief:** Radisson Hotel Group has launched an AI-powered hotel discovery application within ChatGPT, enabling users to search for and receive recommendations on Radisson properties directly through the conversational AI platform. * Radisson Hotel Group Launches AI Hotel Discovery App in ChatGPT - Image Credit Radisson Hotel Group. **Radisson Hotel Group and Accenture have launched an AI-powered hotel discovery app in ChatGPT under the handle @RadissonHotels.**. The app allows travelers to search Radisson Hotels properties in more than 100 countries and across more than 1,000 hotels through ChatGPT conversations. Users can begin a new ChatGPT conversation with @RadissonHotels at the start of a prompt and request hotel recommendations based on destination, amenities or travel needs. Accenture also worked with Radisson Hotel Group on the app’s design and on how travelers interact with it across devices. The ChatGPT app is part of Radisson Hotel Group’s digital transformation and direct booking strategy.

items.title: Oviond Launches MCP Server to Bring Agency Reporting Into Claude, ChatGPT, and Other AI Tools - markets.businessinsider.com
items.summary: # Oviond Launches MCP Server to Bring Agency Reporting Into Claude, ChatGPT, and Other AI Tools. *Marketing reporting software adds Model Context Protocol access while keeping core interface unchanged for non-technical team members.*. United States, July 28, 2026 -- Oviond has released a Model Context Protocol server that lets marketing agencies manage client reporting workflows from AI tools rather than working exclusively inside the Oviond platform. The update connects the reporting software to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and other MCP-compatible clients. "We built Oviond's MCP server so agencies can bring reporting workflows into the AI tools they already use, without turning the core product into a bloated AI interface.". The MCP server does not replace the existing Oviond interface. "The goal is not to replace the Oviond interface," Irwin said. "It is to give agencies a practical second way to work - through Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP-compatible clients - while keeping reporting simple for the rest of the team.".

items.title: Google Ranks, AI Recommends: New Study of 38,000 AI Searches Reveals Which Law Firms Actually Get Named - The National Law Review
items.summary: ### Google Ranks, AI Recommends: New Study of 38,000 AI Searches Reveals Which Law Firms Actually Get Named. Forward Push Law Firm Marketing Logo. *Forward Push analyzed 38,000 AI searches across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude, finding law firm AI visibility looks nothing like Google rankings.*. ATLANTA, GA, UNITED STATES, July 28, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- Forward Push Law Firm Marketing, an agency that works exclusively with law firms, today released the findings of an original research study built on 38,000 AI searches. The study set out to answer a question more law firm owners are asking every month: when someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Claude for the best lawyer in their city, does their firm get named? ChatGPT and Claude named an actual law firm in about 99% of their answers. "Being named by an AI tool is not the same as being the better lawyer," said Marc Apple, Founder and Partner of Forward Push Law Firm Marketing.

items.title: 昨日の熊本地震の 被災地が１日も早く復興することを願います。
items.summary:
昨日の熊本地震の 被災地が１日も早く復興することを願います。 

日本ならどこでも起きる可能性のある規模の地震。

 出来ることは国、自治体、個人の全てで防災対策を徹底し被害を減らすこと。  
東京で起きた場合の被害をchat GPTに予測してもらいました。 

参考まで。 
↓ 
（以下chat GPTの回答を転載）  

昨日の熊本地震（M7.1・最大震度7）と同規模の地震が東京23区直下で発生した場合、東京の人口・建物・インフラの集中を考えると、熊本よりはるかに大きな被害になる可能性があります。  

想定される被害（概算）  
死者：約3,000～6,000人 
負傷者：約5万～9万人
避難者：約200万～300万人
帰宅困難者：約400万人  

被害が大きくなる理由  
人口・建物が極めて密集している 木造住宅密集地で大規模火災が発生しやすい 鉄道・道路・通信など都市機能への影響が全国に波及する  

補足  
これは東京都や政府の首都直下地震（M7.3）想定を基に、M7.1相当へ概算したものです。 
実際の被害は、震源の位置・発生時刻・風の強さによって大きく変わります。 
特に冬の夕方で強風の場合は、火災により被害がさらに拡大する可能性があります。  

（転載終了）
